==Transportation==
* Use a [[Games necklace]] to teleport to [[Burthorpe]], run south to the inn, and go down the trapdoor near the bartender.
* Use a [[Combat bracelet]] to teleport to the [[Warriors' Guild]], then run east to the inn.
* [[Minigame Teleport]] to the [[Burthorpe Games Room]], go upstairs twice, and then run south to the bar.
